'''Fallex''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. While occupied by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], the local [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Unidentified governor|who]] ruled over Fallex was overthrown in an [[Fallex Crisis|uprising]] assisted by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="OAA1" />
